# B Mortgage Services

> Expert mortgage and protection advice for individuals and employers across the UK.

B Mortgage Services is a UK-based mortgage broker offering personalised mortgage and protection advice. The firm has access to a wide range of lenders and specialises in first-time buyers, home movers, remortgaging, and clients with self-employed or otherwise complex income.

## Services

### For Individuals
- Mortgage advice (first-time buyers, remortgaging, home movers)
- Self-employed, contractor and complex income cases
- Buy-to-let and property investment
- Protection (life cover, income protection, critical illness cover)
- Mortgage & Financial Wellness Check

### For Employers
- Employee financial wellness programmes
- Workplace mortgage and protection clinics
- Financial Wellness Check as an employee benefit — at no cost to the organisation

## Fees

- No fee for residential mortgage advice.
- £295 for buy-to-let mortgage advice.

## Free Tools

### Affordability Calculator
URL: https://bmortgageservices.co.uk/affordability-calculator/
An indication of how much you could borrow, based on your income, deposit and financial commitments. What a lender will actually offer depends on your circumstances and their own criteria.

### Budget Planner
URL: https://bmortgageservices.co.uk/budget-planner/
Work out your household budget for a new home and understand what mortgage payment you could comfortably afford.

### Overpayment Calculator
URL: https://bmortgageservices.co.uk/overpayment-calculator/
See how overpaying could reduce the interest you pay and shorten your mortgage term.

### Mortgage & Financial Wellness Check
URL: https://bmortgageservices.co.uk/wellness/
A free three-minute assessment scoring financial preparedness across four pillars: Mortgage Eligibility, Affordability & Budget, Financial Resilience and Protection Readiness. No credit check. It is an indication of preparedness, not a mortgage eligibility score or lending decision.

## Regulatory

B Mortgage Services is a trading style of House Financial Ltd, an appointed representative of The Openwork Partnership, a trading style of Openwork Limited, which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage.

Most buy-to-let mortgages are not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.
